aiSummary: In October 2026, Chrome for Android led browser versions (tablet) in South Africa at 58.62% (market share of tracked page views / usage). Safari iPad ranked second at 16.09%, followed by Chrome iPad at 12.56%.

faqs.question: Which item leads browser versions (tablet) in South Africa?
faqs.answer: Chrome for Android leads at 58.62% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/browser-version-market-share/tablet/south-africa.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for browser versions (tablet) in South Africa?
faqs.answer: Chrome for Android (58.62%), Safari iPad (16.09%), Chrome iPad (12.56%) in October 2026.
